title: ALL ( Sales ) as a filter argument removes filters and adds none
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "Sold", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), Sales ), "AllSales", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), ALL ( Sales ) ) ), Product[Color] = "Red" )

source.quote: ALL requires the removal of any filters from the expanded Sales table, which includes Product[Color]
source.supports: ALL ( Sales ) removes the filters of expanded Sales and returns nothing to filter with: the article's denominator is the count of all products

derivation: Under Color = Red. Sold: Sales is evaluated under the Red filter (rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7); its expanded table keeps products 1 and 2: 2. AllSales: the color filter is removed and no filter is added, so the unsold Scooter counts too: all 4 products.
notes: An engine that treats ALL ( Sales ) as the table of all Sales rows would give 3 for AllSales.
